status: Research-backed guidance and original illustrative interactive previews, not a validated ranking of design effectiveness.

sources.title: 10 Usability Heuristics
sources.finding: Visibility of system status, user control, consistency, prevention and recovery are useful evaluation lenses.
sources.limit: Heuristics are guidance, not proof of conversion uplift.

sources.title: Usability Testing 101
sources.finding: Watch representative people attempt meaningful real tasks and observe where they struggle.
sources.limit: Synthesized personas are not participant evidence.

sources.title: Human Interface Guidelines: Onboarding
sources.finding: Prefer quick, optional, contextual onboarding that teaches through action.
sources.limit: Applies to Apple platforms; not a blanket recommendation to add onboarding.

sources.title: Human Interface Guidelines: Layout
sources.finding: Use familiar groupings, safe areas, flexible layouts and appropriate prominence.
sources.limit: Check the latest OS and device variations.

sources.title: Human Interface Guidelines: Tab bars
sources.finding: Tabs are destinations, not action buttons; preserve position and context.
sources.limit: Not all apps benefit from tab bars.

sources.title: App Review Guidelines
sources.finding: Check review access, platform design, safety, purchase rules, privacy and working services before submitting.
sources.limit: A guide cannot guarantee approval; rules change and vary by region.

sources.title: Core app quality guidelines
sources.finding: Follow platform-appropriate interactions and quality requirements.
sources.limit: This is a current release checklist, not an aesthetic scoring system.

sources.title: Adaptive app quality guidelines
sources.finding: Test multiple window sizes, tablets, foldables and meaningful resize behavior.
sources.limit: Choose applicable tiers and test real app contexts.

sources.title: Build adaptive apps
sources.finding: Use window size classes and layouts that adapt to available space.
sources.limit: Native Compose examples may require translation for React Native or Flutter.

sources.title: Payments policy
sources.finding: Audit payment methods against the current store policy before release.
sources.limit: Policies have exceptions and country-specific rules.

sources.title: Web Content Accessibility Guidelines 2.2
sources.finding: Design and test keyboard, contrast, focus, resizing, target size and other applicable criteria.
sources.limit: Passing automated checks alone is not conformance.

sources.title: Core Web Vitals
sources.finding: Assess LCP, INP and CLS using field evidence and reliable lab tooling.
sources.limit: Targets describe web quality, not ranking guarantees.

sources.title: Product Page UX 2026
sources.finding: Make option selection, image inspection, pricing and essential facts discoverable.
sources.limit: Study targets commerce; do not generalize to every website.

sources.title: Avoid Horizontal Tabs on Product Pages
sources.finding: Prefer expanded or vertically collapsible core product content over easy-to-miss horizontal tabs.
sources.limit: This conclusion concerns ecommerce product details, not all interface tabs.

sources.title: Checkout UX 2025
sources.finding: Reduce confusing fields and totals, show progress and recovery at checkout.
sources.limit: Benchmarks are category-specific and may change.

sources.title: Product Page UX research
sources.finding: Use rich, informative product images and adequate specs to support purchase decisions.
sources.limit: Detailed paid findings must not be copied verbatim.

sources.title: State of Mobile 2026
sources.finding: 2025 global IAP reached $167B; top three nongame earners were TikTok, Google One, ChatGPT according to Sensor Tower.
sources.limit: Revenue ranking does not establish UI causality, profit or store-specific rank.

sources.title: Attention web designers: you have 50 milliseconds
sources.finding: Visual first impressions can form quickly in experimental settings.
sources.limit: Do not claim 50ms as a universal design or conversion rule.

sources.title: The role of visual complexity and prototypicality
sources.finding: Visual complexity and recognizable structures can affect initial aesthetic judgments.
sources.limit: Controlled image experiments are not full-product usability tests.

sources.title: Accessible animation and reduced motion
sources.finding: Adapt large transforms and parallax to reduced-motion preferences.
sources.limit: Implementation guide, not clinical evidence.

sources.title: Three.js manual
sources.finding: 3D is suitable for spatial, inspectable objects when it conveys unique value.
sources.limit: Test battery, memory, FPS, keyboard and static fallbacks.

sources.title: React Three Fiber
sources.finding: Declarative Three.js scenes work within a React composition.
sources.limit: API/version and asset licenses must be checked.

sources.title: model-viewer interactive 3D and AR
sources.finding: A product viewer can let people inspect models and use AR on supported devices.
sources.limit: Not every browser/device supports AR; use a static alternative.

sources.title: WebLLM
sources.finding: Run supported language models in-browser using WebGPU acceleration.
sources.limit: Models can be large and device/browser compatibility varies.

sources.title: Transformers.js WebGPU
sources.finding: Run supported embeddings and other models in browsers, with WebGPU where available.
sources.limit: Not all models or devices support GPU execution.

sources.title: Puter.js documentation
sources.finding: Call cloud AI and storage from front-end JavaScript through user-based accounts.
sources.limit: Not local model inference; users cover their own metered usage.

sources.title: Site-grounded AI chatbot tutorial
sources.finding: Use page-grounded context and disclose that visitors may need a Puter account.
sources.limit: AI outputs still need guardrails, disclosure and user consent.

sources.title: Search Essentials
sources.finding: Publish useful, accessible, crawlable content with clear structure and real expertise.
sources.limit: SEO does not guarantee ranking.

sources.title: Material Design 3
sources.finding: Use system-consistent type, color, component and interaction foundations.
sources.limit: Implementation must follow the actual Android UI framework.

craft.title: Motion and state animation
craft.when: Animate feedback and orientation, never hide content or force scroll.
craft.how: Build meaningful entry, action feedback and reversal. Keep transforms modest, disable nonessential parallax for reduced-motion.

craft.title: 3D and spatial previews
craft.when: Use 3D only to inspect a physical, spatial or creative object.
craft.how: Add a real turntable or orbit-controls model only when geometry explains the product. Provide keyboard support and a static image alternative.

craft.title: Hosted frontend AI
craft.when: Puter.js is user-account cloud AI, not locally executed models.
craft.skills: Puter.js; disclosure; privacy consent; safe prompt construction
craft.how: Add an optional, clearly labeled assistant for a specific task. Require user consent, disclose account/usage, ground responses and gate consequential actions.

craft.title: In-browser on-device AI
craft.when: Local inference can reduce data transfer but depends on device and model weight.
craft.how: Make a small, consented local classification or drafting task. Test WebGPU support, downloads, memory failure and a no-AI fallback.

craft.title: Server-mediated AI
craft.when: Use an authenticated backend for shared data, secrets and centrally paid API calls.
craft.skills: API gateway; auth; rate limiting; data retention
craft.how: Build minimal server endpoint with secret vault, abuse controls and safe logging. Never expose third-party secret keys in frontend code.

craft.title: Accessibility and localization
craft.when: Assistive technology, RTL, enlargement and reduced motion are core states.
craft.how: Test keyboard, reading order, voice labels, touch targets, zoom, translated expansion and right-to-left mirroring with real users/devices.

craft.title: Performance and battery
craft.when: Prioritize meaningful content and smooth response over spectacle.
craft.skills: Core Web Vitals; profiling; lazy loading
craft.how: Measure LCP, INP, CLS for web and real app startup/frame smoothness; defer heavy visuals; provide fallbacks.

craft.title: Discoverability and content
craft.when: Use crawlable meaning, titles, proper metadata and real content.
craft.skills: Search Central; semantic HTML; schema only where valid
craft.how: Write specific metadata, heading hierarchy and readable copy; verify canonical URLs and internal links; avoid generated keyword stuffing.

craft.title: Research-to-wireframe
craft.when: Use real tasks and evidence; choose sections from an explicit goal.
craft.skills: User interviews; journey maps; heuristic review
craft.how: Draft three contrasting layouts, validate on representative tasks and remove unnecessary sections. Separate observed findings from hypotheses.

craft.title: Errors, offline and recovery
craft.when: A polished default screen does not prove real UX quality.
craft.skills: State modeling; undo; optimistic UI; network testing
craft.how: Define empty, loading, slow, offline, permission denied, error, retry, conflict and success for each critical action.

craft.title: iOS and App Store
craft.when: Platform-aware navigation, safe areas, purchase rules and accessible presentation.
craft.skills: Apple HIG; SwiftUI/React Native; StoreKit review
craft.how: Honor safe areas and tab semantics. Check App Review rules and IAP eligibility. Verify restore, account deletion, permissions and real-device VoiceOver.

craft.title: Android and Google Play
craft.when: Adaptive layouts and platform-appropriate billing, back behavior and accessibility.
craft.how: Check Android window classes, back navigation, TalkBack, large screens, Play policies and functional purchase/restore/account-deletion flows.

craft.title: Paywalls and honest billing
craft.when: Present price, term, trials, restore and cancellation plainly.
craft.how: Place paywall after demonstrated value where appropriate; do not claim any arrangement maximizes revenue without experiments.

craft.title: Visual grammar and components
craft.when: Tokens, type, spacing, states and repeatable foundations support coherence.
craft.how: Define 3 typographic roles, spacing scale, color semantics and accessible component states; present 3 distinct art directions.

craft.title: Parent sites and subdomains
craft.when: Connect product site and parent without duplicated, contradictory identity.
craft.how: Design parent company index and focused subdomain landing; expose contextual crosslinks, consistent support/privacy and clear product naming.

craft.title: Preview and device test lab
craft.when: Previews are illustrative until tested in a real rendering environment.
craft.how: Test desktop/tablet/mobile and native iOS/Android where applicable, keyboard, focus, errors, reduced motion, translations, accessibility and performance.
